assumptions.berth_assignment: Estimated deterministic service-to-wagon allocation; not a published assignment
assumptions.lanes: One stopping lane and one independent passing lane per direction, user-selected abstraction
assumptions.demand: Configurable synthetic boarding/alighting, no passenger OD survey
assumptions.linear_reference: Local projection within 650m of published chainage; unlocated street stops interpolate official shape
assumptions.depot: Abstract vehicle staging at journey origin; no invented yard access geometry
assumptions.speed_profile: Rolling speed and stopped share per 100 m of corridor, measured from the official realtime feed on the days listed in speed_field.json; the published stretch time still sets the total
assumptions.vehicle_type: Body type per service read from the fleet labels of the official realtime feed; services without readings fall back to the articulated reference, marked as an estimate

excluded.reason: Chapinero Ciclovía pertenece al componente zonal, que este simulador no modela. El catálogo genérico la etiqueta TransMilenio, por lo que ese campo no basta para delimitar el alcance.
excluded.name: Chapinero Ciclovía

excluded.reason: Variante Banderas duplicada: F23 termina únicamente en Portal Américas, así que se conserva el registro ID396 y se excluye esta.
excluded.name: Banderas
